inner-sm.$description: The mark inside a small control — Checkbox sm, Tag count, ChartLegend swatch. Radius tracks the control's size: sm marks take 4px, md take 6px

inner.$description: Marks nested inside a control: checkbox box, tag close target

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects — anything you click or type into

surface-sm.$description: The step between a control and a surface — compact floating panels, small tracks, nested rows, mid-size cells. Five consumers, and OTP proves the ramp: sm cell 8px, md 10px, lg 12px

surface.$description: Cards, toasts, callouts, tables, popovers — anything that holds content

surface-lg.$description: A frame that holds a surface — the ground around a list that is itself a surface (ProjectList, ADR-0166): one step past the surface it holds

surface-xl.$description: A reading panel floating on a map, and the card a map tool opens (ADR-0172): what is read takes the large curve, what is pressed the pill — two steps past the cards it holds (surface-lg, 16)

pill.$description: Badges, avatars, dots, toggles — anything fully rounded
